steps.note: N0.1 states the eight-row schedule changes the target by (JV+RG)x independent of the initial scratch values a,c, quoting line 748 'Rows 6 and 7 restore c,a'; N0's method also has each invocation restore the scratch values.
N0.2 gives central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, side injection cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, zero for intersections zero or two, and coefficient one for T=S.
N0.3 states central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, side cancelling for intersections zero and two, intersection one contributing zero, self coefficient one.
N0.4 and N0's method give the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) with every scratch wire restored.

The plan only says in L0's method that each edge's orthogonal residual is 'read from a table'; no residual or dimension entry of the table is stated (L0.4 gives only that edges join comparable labels).
L0.3 has the nesting P(x)<t_X> inside P(x)t_Y-perp from t_X perp t_Y, but never the edge 2->5 residual, the complement <t_X,t_Y>-perp, or its dimension h-2.
L0.4 gives center 3->4 as the only decreasing edge losing h; R0.1 gives telescoping with sources N, sinks Wm-N, signed Wm-2N; R0.2 gives L=Ich and absolute total Wm-2N+2L.
L0.5 (and P0.4) only assert that nonzero binary residuals have orthonormal bases; nondegeneracy, nonalternating (norm-one vector) and absorbing alternating planes are not stated.
